title: Purpose.
bodyText: The purpose of this chapter is to provide incentives and protection for physicians engaging in effective professional peer review.
history: [L 1989, c 354, pt of §3 and c 363, pt of §3]
bodyHtml: [§671D-2]  Purpose.  The purpose of this chapter is to provide incentives and protection for physicians engaging in effective professional peer review. [L 1989, c 354, pt of §3 and c 363, pt of §3]
